description: CBC / Hamilton Parker vendor multiplier tiers. cost = list price x multiplier.
rule: The multiplier is a per-vendor account attribute (a tier), not a per-item value. MAP is not cost.
phase_1_scope: Top-10 vendors only - about 90% of quote volume.
